# SunGo Solar

> SunGo Solar is a solar energy company in Gujranwala, Punjab, Pakistan. It is an official dealer of Knox, Itel and Photon, sells solar panels, inverters and lithium batteries, and installs solar systems for homes, shops, factories and tube-wells across Punjab. Founded in 2022; more than 500 solar systems installed.

## Key facts

- Name: SunGo Solar
- Type: Solar dealer and installer
- Address: Gondala Wala Road, near Al-Miraj Fans, Block B, Model Town, Gujranwala 52400, Punjab, Pakistan
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 300 6474333, +92 302 6261319
- Opening hours: Saturday to Thursday, 10:00 am to 10:00 pm. Closed on Friday.
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/6Q9E9SHRno4ZBsvp6
- Founded: 2022
- Installations: more than 500 solar systems
- Branches: one shop only, in Gujranwala. No branches in other cities; the installation team travels to customers.
- Areas where the team installs: Gujranwala, Lahore, Sialkot, Wazirabad, Gujrat, Faisalabad and other cities in Punjab
- Founder & CEO: Javed Akram
- Head of Technical Team: Zahid Akram
- Head of Sales Support: Shahbaz Akram

## Official dealerships

- Knox: inverters (4 kW to 9.2 kW, including Krypton and Zapher models) and Powerwall lithium batteries
- Itel: inverters (including Sparta 6.6 kW IP66) and lithium batteries
- Photon: lithium batteries (24V and 51V)

## Other brands sold

- Solar panels: Canadian Solar, Longi, Jinko, JA Solar, Astronergy, Jesko, Risen, Aiko (585W to 740W, including HJT and bifacial panels)
- Inverters: MaxPower, Solis, GoodWe, Fronus, Sofar, NS
- Lithium batteries: Pylontech, Volnex, Pytes, Royal, Hisel, Fronus, Sofar

## Services

- Home solar installation
- Shop and factory solar installation
- Tube-well (agricultural) solar
- Net metering help
- After-sales service, maintenance and warranty support
